Crime & Law · India

Temple donation claims spark police complaints and political debate

MNS chief Raj Thackeray alleged that Rs 18 crore is stolen annually from the Siddhivinayak Temple donations. Separately, seers and lawyers filed police complaints regarding a skit about Ram Temple donations in Parliament. The Ram Temple Trust stated that no money is missing from its donations, citing robust management systems. An SIT is investigating alleged irregularities in the purchase of flowers and event expenses for the Ram Temple.
